stem: According to the author, when you are deciding on a speech topic —

options.label: F
options.text: it is usually best to choose something you care strongly about

options.label: G
options.text: the subject itself is less important than your speaking style

options.label: H
options.text: you should avoid ideas that have been used too many times

options.label: J
options.text: the issue should reflect concerns you share with other people
